Cofoundaz signature certificate
Certificate page 2
These are simple electronic signatures: each signer typed their name to adopt it as their signature. Cofoundaz records the signer's
email, IP address, browser, the time and the document's SHA-256 hash, but does not issue a certificate-based or qualified signature
and is not a trust service provider. Whether a typed-name signature is enforceable depends on the document and the jurisdiction;
take legal advice for high-stakes agreements.
